title: Fall of Wall Maria
desc: The Colossal and Armored Titans appear, breaching Shiganshina and devastating humanity's outer defenses.

title: Battle of Trost
desc: The Colossal Titan strikes again, but Eren discovers his shifting ability, ultimately sealing the gate.

title: The Female Titan
desc: The 57th Exterior Scouting Mission ends in disaster as an intelligent Female Titan decimates the Survey Corps.

title: Clash of the Titans
desc: Betrayal from within. The identities of the Armored and Colossal Titans are revealed in a shocking confrontation.

title: Return to Shiganshina
desc: The ultimate gamble. The Survey Corps faces Zeke, Reiner, and Bertholdt to reclaim Wall Maria and discover the basement's truth.

title: Marley Arc
desc: Eren infiltrates Liberio, launching a preemptive strike on the world stage and igniting a global conflict.

title: The Rumbling
desc: The Founding Titan is unleashed. Millions of Colossal Titans march across the earth, bringing the apocalypse.
